categories.name: AI & Technology
categories.focus: AI research and products, AI agents and agentic tooling, coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, vibe coding), the major labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind), and AI hardware such as Nvidia GPUs. Include notable general tech developments.

categories.name: Elon Musk & US Politics
categories.focus: Elon Musk's ventures and statements, and US political developments including the Trump administration, Congress, and major policy moves.

categories.name: Science, Nature & Physics
categories.focus: Fundamental science: physics, quantum research, biology, chemistry, and notable discoveries from the natural world. Exclude space and health, which have their own categories.

categories.name: German & EU Politics
categories.focus: German domestic politics, EU institutions and policy, Brussels decision-making, and Martin Sonneborn's statements.

categories.name: World News
categories.focus: Significant general world news and major international events that don't fall neatly into the other categories.

categories.name: Investing & Markets
categories.focus: Stock markets, company earnings, macroeconomics, central banks (Fed/ECB), and investing trends.

categories.name: Space & Astronomy
categories.focus: Rocket launches and spaceflight, NASA/ESA missions, astronomy discoveries, telescopes, and planetary science.

categories.name: Health & Medicine
categories.focus: Medical research, clinical trials, drugs and biotech, public health, and notable healthcare developments.

categories.name: Geopolitics & Defense
categories.focus: Armed conflicts, military and defense developments, NATO, international diplomacy, sanctions, and geopolitical tensions.

categories.name: Energy
categories.focus: Energy technology and deployment: renewables (solar, wind), nuclear fission, and emerging energy tech such as fusion, plus grid and storage. Focus on the technology and industry, NOT climate policy or emissions debates.

categories.name: Gaming: AI & Board Games
categories.focus: Two things only: (1) video games that use AI in core gameplay — AI-driven NPCs, AI characters/companions, generative or procedural systems as game mechanics; and (2) board games and tabletop gaming. Ignore routine game releases, reviews, and industry/business news that don't involve AI mechanics or tabletop.
